correctness.rationale: For q=3, n=5, one deletion and SET-valued shadows, independently enumerated all 3^4=81 targets and 3^5=243 candidate centers. The ten alphabet-permutation/reversal orbits give 81 targets of aggregate nonnegative integer dual weight 468. Every center has distinct-descendant weight at most 23 (attained by 126 centers). Hence any cover size is >=ceil(468/23)=21. Expanding seven published prototypes by three common alphabet translates yields exactly 21 distinct centers and partitions all 81 targets once. Reconstructed covering/duality inequalities; complete finite exhaustive proof, not a sampling argument.
